character: A man in his late fifties, very big and heavy through the shoulders, thickening with age. A broad weather-creased face, deep lines at the eyes, a salt-and-pepper beard kept slightly unkempt. Thick grey-brown hair. An old scar through one eyebrow. Heavy-lidded and level, watching
wardrobe: a heavy worn dark brown coat, practical and unadorned, cuffs gone shiny with use, over a plain shirt open at the throat, a leather cord disappearing under the collar, and scuffed boots resoled many times

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing squarely with his weight settled back, arms loose at his sides, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer directly, chin slightly lowered.

scene.framing: A guildmaster standing behind a heavy desk in a small cluttered upper floor office, maps pinned across the wall behind him, a shortsword lying on the desktop, one hand flat on a stack of papers, low lamplight, a narrow window showing a river bridge at dusk.
